title: U.S. House, District 7
what_it_does: Represents Florida's 7th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives; votes on federal laws and spending.
verified_ballot_note: AP/NPR/Roll Call (Aug 18, 2026) report Ryan Elijah defeated incumbent Cory Mills in the Republican primary; FOX 35 and a syndicated report state Elijah will face Democrat Bale Dalton in November (https://www.npr.org/2026/08/18/nx-s1-5936435/mills-elijah-florida-republican-primary ; https://www.fox35orlando.com/news/florida-primary-election-result-2026-cd7 ; https://www.fox35orlando.com/news/florida-congressional-district-7-election-results). No incumbent is on the November ballot. NPA/write-in candidates not confirmed. Florida's Legislature passed a new congressional map in the April 2026 special session (Senate vote 21-17 on April 29, 2026) and the Florida Supreme Court on June 10, 2026 declined (6-1) to block it, so the new district lines apply to the Nov. 3, 2026 election; litigation on the merits continues. (https://floridaphoenix.com/2026/04/29/florida-legislature-passes-desantis-congressional-redistricting-map/; https://mynews13.com/fl/orlando/news/2026/06/10/florida-supreme-court-clears-way-for-new-redistricting-map-in-2026; https://www.wusf.org/politics-issues/2026-06-11/florida-supreme-court-rejects-challenge-new-redistricting-map) County list reflects pre-2026 district boundaries unless a 2026 source is cited; boundaries changed under the April 2026 map and the exact new county composition was not confirmed in searches run for this guide.

candidates.name: Ryan Elijah
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.occupation: Former FOX 35 Orlando television news anchor (Emmy winner) and former NFL sideline reporter
candidates.residence: Central Florida (Seminole/Volusia area); specific city not verified. Florida Politics reports he has lived in Florida about 20 years and ran for Congress in Indiana in 2010
candidates.background: Ryan Elijah, a former television news anchor, won the Aug. 18, 2026 Republican primary in the 7th District, leading incumbent Rep. Cory Mills about 47% to 34% with more than 95% of votes counted, per AP. Mills, who had been endorsed by President Trump, was the subject of an ongoing House Ethics investigation. Elijah is an Emmy-winning former FOX 35 Orlando anchor and NFL sideline reporter who has lived in Florida about 20 years; he ran for Congress in Indiana in 2010 (Florida Politics). President Trump endorsed him after the primary. He says affordability would be his first priority and has said he has 'never been a fan' of tariffs (News 6).

candidates.name: Bale Dalton
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.occupation: Retired U.S. Navy captain (24 years active and reserve); former NASA chief of staff; former State Department and U.S. Senate staffer
candidates.residence: Central Florida (Seminole/Volusia area); specific city not verified
candidates.background: Bale Dalton is a U.S. Naval Academy graduate who served 24 years in the Navy and Navy Reserve, including 13 on active duty, flying medevac missions in Kuwait, delivering relief after Hurricane Katrina and directing combat air support in Afghanistan (campaign site; Florida Politics). He later worked at the State Department and for Sen. Bill Nelson, and served as NASA's chief of staff. He won the Aug. 18, 2026 Democratic primary in the 7th District over former Rep. Alan Grayson and Marialana Kinter and faces Republican Ryan Elijah in November. His campaign centers on affordability, health-care costs and ACA subsidies, and veterans' issues.
candidates.primary_result: Won Aug 18, 2026 Democratic primary over Alan Grayson and Marialana Kinter; led with more than 45% in Volusia County per Florida Politics; district-wide percentage not found (Florida Politics: https://floridapolitics.com/archives/814941-bale-dalton-officially-snags-democratic-nomination-in-battleground-cd-7/ ; FOX 35: https://www.fox35orlando.com/news/florida-primary-election-result-2026-cd7)

taxes.summary: Dalton says working families in Volusia and Seminole counties need a tax cut and supports tax relief for working families, seniors and small businesses, while opposing tax giveaways to billionaires and corporations and opposing Medicaid cuts.
